1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""cases.py - general helper for reference/cases.csv (Indiana dig-damage enforcement cases).
3	
4	Standard library only. No precomputed answers: every figure comes from running a command.
5	The definitions below follow the PREAMBLE text word for word (see README.md for the text itself):
6	  case = one row; year = year of order_date; cite/base section/qualifier; headline penalty;
7	  utility respondent (prefix test, ignoring case and leading spaces).
8	
9	Usage (run from the folder root):
10	  python3 reference/tools/cases.py [--csv PATH] COMMAND [filters] [options]
11	
12	Commands:
13	  fields                     list columns and derived fields
14	  count                      number of rows that pass the filters (with the denominator)
15	  group  --by F[,F2]         rows per group; add --stat F for n/sum/mean/median per group
16	  stat   --field F           n, sum, mean, median, min, max (and --pcts) of a numeric field
17	  distinct --field F         distinct values of a field with counts
18	  repeat --by F --min K      keys that occur at least K times (default F=respondent_norm)
19	  dupes                      duplicate (order_file, case_number) and multi-order case numbers
20	  receipts [--n N]           example rows (order_file, page, case_number, cite, penalty, respondent)
21	  test-parse "TEXT"          show how one cite / recommendation / respondent string is parsed
22	
23	Filters (all combine with AND; every command takes them):
24	  --year Y[,Y2]  --base S[,S2]  --qual Q[,Q2]|none|any  --cite TEXT  --utility yes|no
25	  --penalty-min N --penalty-max N  --zero-penalty  --rec-contains TEXT  --respondent-contains TEXT
26	  --contains FIELD=TEXT  --eq FIELD=VALUE  --blank FIELD  --notblank FIELD  --scan yes|no
27	  --order-file NAME  --exclude-bad     (drops rows whose case_number is not 5 digits or whose cite is blank)
28	  --expr "PYTHON BOOLEAN EXPRESSION over r"   (r is a row dict with the derived fields; builtins limited)
29	"""
30	import argparse
31	import csv
32	import os
33	import re
34	import statistics
35	import sys
36	from collections import Counter, defaultdict
37	
38	HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
39	DEFAULT_CSV = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "cases.csv")
40	
41	# ---- PREAMBLE definitions -------------------------------------------------------------
42	
43	UTILITY_PREFIXES = [
44	    "CenterPoint", "Northern Indiana Public Service", "NIPSCO", "Citizens Gas",
45	    "Citizens Energy", "Vectren", "Indiana American Water", "Ohio Valley Gas",
46	    "American Electric Power", "Duke Energy", "Community Natural Gas",
47	    "Midwest Natural Gas", "Frontier Communications",
48	]
49	
50	CITE_PREFIX = "IC 8-1-26-"
51	# A parenthesized word is two or more letters (hyphens allowed). (h), (a)(2), (3)(b) are not.
52	_QUAL_RE = re.compile(r"\(([A-Za-z][A-Za-z-]+)\)")
53	# First dollar amount: one or more "$", digits with optional thousands commas (a space after a
54	# comma is ignored), optional decimals. A recommendation with no "$" amount has penalty 0.
55	_MONEY_RE = re.compile(r"\$+\s*(\d+(?:,\s?\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?)")
56	
57	
58	def qualifier(cite):
59	    """The parenthesized word(s) of a cite ('' if none). Two qualifiers would be joined with '+'."""
60	    return "+".join(_QUAL_RE.findall(cite or ""))
61	
62	
63	def base_section(cite):
64	    """Cite without 'IC 8-1-26-' and without any parenthesized word."""
65	    s = (cite or "").strip()
66	    if s.startswith(CITE_PREFIX):
67	        s = s[len(CITE_PREFIX):]
68	    return _QUAL_RE.sub("", s).strip()
69	
70	
71	def headline_penalty(rec):
72	    """First dollar amount in the recommendation as printed; doubled '$' and a space after a
73	    thousands comma are ignored. No '$' amount -> 0.0. (Unconditional: 'Training or $5,000 if ...'
74	    has headline 5000 by this rule.)"""
75	    m = _MONEY_RE.search(rec or "")
76	    if not m:
77	        return 0.0
78	    return float(m.group(1).replace(",", "").replace(" ", ""))
79	
80	
81	def is_utility(respondent):
82	    """Respondent name, ignoring case and leading spaces, starts with one of UTILITY_PREFIXES."""
83	    s = (respondent or "").lstrip().casefold()
84	    return any(s.startswith(p.casefold()) for p in UTILITY_PREFIXES)
85	
86	
87	def order_year(row):
88	    return int(row["order_date"][:4])
89	
90	
91	def norm_name(name):
92	    """Display-safe grouping key: case-folded, whitespace collapsed, trailing . , stripped.
93	    Does NOT merge spelling variants or corporate suffixes (see rules.md)."""
94	    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", (name or "").strip()).casefold().rstrip(".,")
95	
96	
97	def _date(s):
98	    from datetime import datetime
99	    for f in ("%m/%d/%Y", "%Y-%m-%d"):
100	        try:
101	            return datetime.strptime((s or "").strip(), f).date()
102	        except ValueError:
103	            pass
104	    return None
105	
106	
107	def city(location):
108	    loc = (location or "")
109	    return loc.rsplit(",", 1)[1].strip() if "," in loc else ""
110	
111	
112	def enrich(r):
113	    r["cite"] = r["violations"]
114	    r["base"] = base_section(r["violations"])
115	    r["qualifier"] = qualifier(r["violations"])
116	    r["headline"] = headline_penalty(r["recommendation"])
117	    r["utility"] = "yes" if is_utility(r["respondent"]) else "no"
118	    r["year"] = order_year(r)
119	    r["respondent_norm"] = norm_name(r["respondent"])
120	    r["other_party_norm"] = norm_name(r["other_party"])
121	    d = _date(r["damage_date"])
122	    o = _date(r["order_date"])
123	    r["damage_year"] = d.year if d else ""
124	    r["order_month"] = r["order_date"][:7]
125	    r["lag_days"] = (o - d).days if (d and o) else ""
126	    r["city"] = city(r["damage_location"])
127	    r["case_key"] = r["order_file"] + "|" + r["case_number"]
128	    return r
129	
130	
131	def load(path=None):
132	    path = path or DEFAULT_CSV
133	    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
134	        rows = [enrich(r) for r in csv.DictReader(f)]
135	    for r in rows:
136	        r["page"] = int(r["page"])
137	    return rows
138	
139	
140	# ---- filtering ------------------------------------------------------------------------
141	
142	def _csvlist(s):
143	    return [x.strip() for x in s.split(",")] if s else []
144	
145	
146	def build_filter(a):
147	    desc = []
148	    preds = []
149	    if a.year:
150	        ys = {int(y) for y in _csvlist(a.year)}
151	        preds.append(lambda r: r["year"] in ys); desc.append("year in %s" % sorted(ys))
152	    if a.base:
153	        bs = set(_csvlist(a.base))
154	        preds.append(lambda r: r["base"] in bs); desc.append("base in %s" % sorted(bs))
155	    if a.qual:
156	        if a.qual == "none":
157	            preds.append(lambda r: r["qualifier"] == "")
158	        elif a.qual == "any":
159	            preds.append(lambda r: r["qualifier"] != "")
160	        else:
161	            qs = set(_csvlist(a.qual))
162	            preds.append(lambda r: r["qualifier"] in qs)
163	        desc.append("qualifier = %s" % a.qual)
164	    if a.cite:
165	        preds.append(lambda r: r["cite"] == a.cite); desc.append("cite == %r" % a.cite)
166	    if a.utility:
167	        preds.append(lambda r: r["utility"] == a.utility); desc.append("utility respondent = %s" % a.utility)
168	    if a.penalty_min is not None:
169	        preds.append(lambda r: r["headline"] >= a.penalty_min); desc.append("headline >= %g" % a.penalty_min)
170	    if a.penalty_max is not None:
171	        preds.append(lambda r: r["headline"] <= a.penalty_max); desc.append("headline <= %g" % a.penalty_max)
172	    if a.zero_penalty:
173	        preds.append(lambda r: r["headline"] == 0); desc.append("headline == 0")
174	    if a.rec_contains:
175	        t = a.rec_contains.casefold()
176	        preds.append(lambda r: t in r["recommendation"].casefold()); desc.append("recommendation contains %r (any case)" % a.rec_contains)
177	    if a.respondent_contains:
178	        t = a.respondent_contains.casefold()
